nodes.label: Error State Illustration
nodes.description: Colorful flat illustration of a pet carrier/crate with its door open and an orange cat tail peeking out from behind. Rendered in a dark blue-grey palette with yellow/amber accent. Used as the visual illustration on error or empty-state screens (ErrorView) to convey a friendly, non-threatening error message.
nodes.visual_design: Square ~500x500px flat cartoon illustration; dark blue-grey carrier body, open left door, yellow-orange cat tail emerging from back-right; thick dark outlines; warm yellow accent at base
nodes.purpose: Decorative illustration for error or empty states to maintain a friendly tone when something goes wrong in the app
